answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to measure both fluency and faithfulness of generated text. Following existing KG-to-text work, we employ standard metrics BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE-L... Thus, we use BARTScore and FactCC for comparing the generated text with the linearized input graph for measuring faithfulness.
